sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and value-oriented sectors like Real Estate and Healthcare are showing robust all-green breadth, while established momentum leaders Technology and Industrials show early signs of fading.

Market breadth is concentrated, with 4 of 11 sectors—Real Estate, Healthcare, Financials, and Utilities—achieving "all-green" status, meaning they are positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD. Real Estate leads this group with a momentum score of 0.70 (rank 4), while Healthcare has surged 2 spots over the last five sessions to rank 8th with a momentum score of 0.63. Energy has also claimed the top overall rank, rising 2 spots to rank 1 with a momentum score of 0.57.

Conversely, high-momentum growth and cyclical sectors are starting to lose their grip. Industrials (momentum 0.70) and Technology (momentum 0.68) both slipped 1 rank spot this week. Communication Services experienced the sharpest decline, dropping 2 spots to rank 10 with a weak momentum score of 0.22, while Consumer Cyclical remains anchored at the bottom of the table (rank 11, momentum 0.15).

## Strength
* **Healthy Breadth:** Four sectors are "all-green" across all timeframes (weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD): Real Estate, Healthcare, Financials, and Utilities.
* **Real Estate Leading:** Real Estate sits at a momentum score of 0.70 (rank 4), making it the strongest of the all-green cohort.
* **Healthcare Surging:** Healthcare gained 2 spots over the last five sessions to reach rank 8, backed by a strong momentum score of 0.63.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Energy on Top:** Energy is the week's top gainer alongside Healthcare, improving 2 spots to capture the rank 1 position with a momentum score of 0.57.
* **Peak Momentum:** Industrials and Real Estate share the highest momentum scores at 0.70, followed closely by Technology at 0.68.
* **Deep Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.15, rank 11) and Communication Services (momentum 0.22, rank 10) continue to severely lag the broader market, with Communication Services dropping 2 spots in the last five sessions.

## Divergences
* **Fading Leaders:** Despite holding top-tier momentum scores, Industrials (0.70, rank 3) and Technology (0.68, rank 2) each slipped 1 rank spot over the last 5 sessions, signaling potential exhaustion.
* **Fragile All-Green:** Financials and Healthcare are currently "all-green" but display low agreement scores of 0.38 and 0.39 respectively, indicating their positive multi-timeframe profile is highly unstable.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** On June 26, 2026, US industry breadth remains healthy with 41 of 144 groups in "all-green" territory, led by heavy machinery and healthcare plans, while a sharp defensive rotation lifts drug manufacturers and regulated water utilities at the expense of solar and defense.

Industrial and healthcare leaders continue to anchor the market's sustained strength. Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (momentum 0.88) and Textile Manufacturing (momentum 0.87) remain dominant, while Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.87) and Airlines (momentum 0.85) exhibit robust all-green profiles. This is accompanied by a strong defensive rotation, with Drug Manufacturers - General and Utilities - Regulated Water both jumping 23 spots in rank this week.

In contrast, growth and energy-related areas are fading rapidly. Solar plummeted 41 spots to rank 91, while Aerospace & Defense and Internet Content & Information both tumbled 34 spots. Early-warning signals also show momentum cooling in heavyweights like Semiconductors (rank -8) and Diversified Banks (rank -6), indicating a potential pause in these previously dominant groups.

## Strength
* **All-Green Breadth:** 41 of 144 industry groups maintain positive performance across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD).
* **Sustained Leadership:** Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (momentum 0.88, YTD rank 6) and Textile Manufacturing (momentum 0.87, YTD rank 8) lead the 36 groups with sustained 1/3/6-month strength.
* **Real Estate & Healthcare Alignment:** REITs are showing broad strength, with REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.85), REIT - Healthcare Facilities (0.78), and REIT - Retail (0.77) all achieving all-green status.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Drug Manufacturers - General (+23 spots to rank 59, momentum 0.73) and Utilities - Regulated Water (+23 spots to rank 48, momentum 0.64) led the weekly advances, alongside REIT - Healthcare Facilities (+22 spots to rank 36, momentum 0.78).
* **Top Losers:** Solar fell 41 spots to rank 91 (momentum 0.34), while Aerospace & Defense and Internet Content & Information both dropped 34 spots (momentum 0.37 for both).
* **Momentum Extremes:** Semiconductor Equipment & Materials remains a top momentum leader (0.86, YTD rank 2), whereas Pharmaceutical Retailers (0.07, YTD rank 144) and Footwear & Accessories (0.10, YTD rank 137) anchor the laggards.

## Divergences
* **Fading Leaders:** Several high-momentum groups are slipping in rank, led by Semiconductors (momentum 0.68, down 8 spots) and Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.66, down 6 spots).
* **Emerging Defensive Plays:** Lower-momentum groups are jumping in rank, indicating early accumulation in Waste Management (+15 spots, momentum 0.50), Insurance Brokers (+12 spots, momentum 0.40), and Medical Care Facilities (+9 spots, momentum 0.47).
* **Fragile Strength:** Department Stores is flagged as a fragile all-green group due to low agreement (0.48).
